subject: integration
name: SQLite (sqlite3.wasm)
summary: SQLite engine as sqlite3.wasm from @sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm 3.53.4-build1 (Apache-2.0 wrapper, SQLite public domain), pinned by exact version, lockfile integrity and this SHA-256; a site is served the copy only when its own file hashes to it. A library has no state and no grants, and the module imports file, clock, environment and memory calls only, no socket call, so it reaches no network and shows the person to no one. Level 4 with privacy; nothing here rebuilds the binary from SQLite's source. Judged here by its publisher.
